title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and Company's tariff M.D.P.U. No, 379 for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Power Cost Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and inplement the intent of sectins 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
